  - text: CLASS 10 · CIRCLE PROOFS
  - heading "Equal Chords and Equal Angles" [level=1]
  - paragraph: Explore the relationship between equal chords and equal angles at a circle's centre.
  - text: 30 min RIGOROUS PROOF geometry2d
  - navigation:
    - button "Interact"
    - button "Learn"
    - button "Example"

  - main:
    - heading "INVESTIGATE" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Drag points A, B, C or D. Observe angles and chord lengths.
    - strong: "Theorem: Equal chords ↔ Equal central angles"
    - complementary:
      - heading "CONTROLS" [level=3]
      - text: Display

      - text: Show radii OA, OB, OC, OD

      - text: Equal angles ⇔ Equal chords STATUS
      - strong: ✓ AB = CD
      - strong: ∠AOB = ∠COD
      - emphasis: The theorem holds.
    - article:
      - img "Draggable equal chords circle": Chord Tangent Angle A B C D O 54° 54° AB = 6.00 cm CD = 6.00 cm
      - strong: AB = 6.00 cm
      - strong: CD = 6.00 cm
      - strong: ∠AOB = 54°
      - strong: ∠COD = 54°
    - complementary:
      - heading "TOOLS" [level=3]
      - button "Drag":
        - img

      - paragraph: ● B
      - paragraph: ● C
      - paragraph: ● D
      - paragraph: ● O Centre
    - text: Drag any point or use the rotation slider. Locked chord lengths stay equal.
    - article:
      - heading "WHY IT WORKS" [level=2]
      - paragraph: Equal chords in the same circle are equidistant from the centre. Radii to the endpoints form two isosceles triangles with equal legs and equal bases.
      - text: △ AOB ≅ △ COD
    - article:
      - heading "WORKED EXAMPLE" [level=2]
      - paragraph: "Given: AB = CD"
      - paragraph: "Prove: ∠AOB = ∠COD"
      - list:
        - listitem: OA=OC and OB=OD (radii).
        - listitem: AB=CD (given).
        - listitem: △AOB ≅ △COD (SSS).
        - listitem: ∠AOB=∠COD (CPCTC).
    - article:
      - heading "WARNING" [level=2]
      - paragraph: Comparing arcs by appearance does not establish equal chord lengths.
      - text: ◯ ╱ ✕
      - strong: Always compare chords or use the measurements.
    - heading "CHALLENGE" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Set both chords to 6 cm and rotate one without changing its central angle.
    - article:
      - paragraph: ✓ Set AB = 6 cm
      - paragraph: ✓ Set CD = 6 cm
      - paragraph: ③ Rotate point C (and D) around the circle. Keep ∠COD = 54°.
    - article:
      - heading "Goal" [level=3]
      - paragraph: Maintain ∠COD = 54° while changing the position of CD.
      - strong: Well done! CD remains 6.00 cm.
      - emphasis: ✓ Theorem verified.
    - strong: 3/3 Complete
